name: A Clerk's Daybook
desc: The toll stamp remains with the collector. The office key hangs beneath the reception desk; search there before trying the doors. A dry page records the clerk's last errand: ‘I had to find the proper form templates in the Scribe’s Office, check their validity with the Auditor, then stop in the Break Room to grab an apple. There I remembered my ruler in the Scribe’s Office. After fetching it, I went straight to the Toll Collector’s Office.’ Follow the named rooms in that order, including the return visit.

name: Office Key
desc: A brass key recovered from beneath the reception desk. It opens the doors of the office section. The daybook records the sequence leading to the collector.

name: Toll Stamp
desc: Taken from the Toll Collector. Kept as a record of the kill; it has no other use.
